topic: In-situ Stubble Management (खेत में पराली प्रबंधन)
solutions: 1. Happy Seeder / Smart Seeder: Sows wheat directly into standing paddy stubble without prior burning. 2. Super Seeder: Mulches paddy residue into soil and sows wheat in a single tractor pass. 3. Pusa Bio-decomposer: Microbial spray that accelerates in-field residue decomposition in 20-25 days, enriching soil organic carbon by 0.1-0.2%.
benefits: Preserves 5.5 kg Nitrogen, 2.3 kg Phosphorus, 25 kg Potash, and 1.2 kg Sulphur per ton of straw, which are completely lost during burning.

topic: Ex-situ Stubble Utilization (खेत के बाहर पराली का उपयोग)
solutions: Straw balers compact loose straw into dense 15-25 kg square or round bales. Bales are purchased by 2G bio-ethanol refineries, biomass co-firing thermal power plants, cardboard mills, and mushroom growers at ₹1,500-2,500 per ton.
subsidy: Central CRM (Crop Residue Management) scheme provides up to 50% individual subsidy on machines and 80% to Custom Hiring Centers (CHCs).
